content.comment_body: I am Spanish and using Google translator, apologies. I want to control a tank using [product_name] with display plus [product_name] analog module and a 4-20 mA level sensor. The hardware includes: a [product_name] basis module [article_no], an analog module [article_no], a [product_name] power module, and a passive 4-20 mA level sensor (1 bar). I built my program with [product_name] engineering software [version_no] and tested it in the simulator. Before proceeding, I have some questions: 1) Where should I connect the level sensor? Should it be connected to pin M1 I1 on my analog module? 2) How do I configure [product_name] basis module to recognize the analog AM2 module? I am unsure about this configuration. 3) Regarding analog input usage, does my [product_name] have 8 analog inputs from the analog module? Is the analog input AI9? Thank you.

The [product_name] basis module [article_no] has 4 analog inputs. Within the file display configuration, you can choose to use 0, 2, or 4 analog inputs. By default, 2 analog inputs (AI1, AI2) are enabled. The analog input numbering for the expansion module starts after these. For example: - With 0 analog inputs enabled in the base module, the first input on the expansion module is AI1. - With 2 enabled, the first for the expansion module is AI3. - With 4 enabled, the first for the expansion module is AI5.
Sorry for the delay. Thank you, [user_name]. I followed your advice and the issue is resolved. Regards.
